description: For event types with `repeatMax` (from get_public_profile): lists each meeting of a series that starts at `start` (one of the slots) and repeats `every` 1, 2 or 4 weeks at the same local time, and whether each is free. Book it with create_booking and `repeat` when `bookable` is true. A series is booked whole or not at all, and round robin gives every meeting to the same host.
